regions.merged_text: "THANK GOD NOW. , AHEAD OF TIME FOR ALL THAT IS COMING TO US. INCLUDE OUR DEATHS WITH ALL THE CIRCUMSTANCES CONNECTED WITH THEM. ( DEATH IS THE CLIMAX OF ALL HUMILIATION, WHEN WE MUST FINALLY GIVE UP ALL, AND TURN ALL OVER TO GOD. DEATH CAN BE VERY BEAUTIFUL -- LIKE A WEDDING, IF WE MAKE IT SO. DEATH IS STILL BETTER WHEN WE ARE CONSCIOUS, AND KNOW."

regions.merged_text: Many thanks and God's blessing to every associate and to every associate's every neighbor. May the Holy Ghost teach us all something at least of appreciation - of gratitude - for the inestimable privilege of serv- ing God and saving our own immortal souls by helping one another! This incidently we might add, according to the definition of religion, rather say, in harmony with "Religion; the Science of our supremely privileged, happy dependence on Almighty God and our neighbor" (each rational creature being its own first neighbor). The definition holds for every rational creature - alike in Heaven, on Earth and in Purgatory; not in Hell, because they are not rational there, the acknow- ledged headquarters of atheism. Atheism? "The unqualified climax at once of in- tellectual insanity, of moral degeneresy, diabolical blasphemy.
